text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 5, 2025) for 15 Dundonald Street.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 5, 2025) for 15 Dundonald Street, Folder Number 25 152025 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to October 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
